message.content:
Based on my search, the capital of France is **Paris**.

Paris has been the capital of France since 508 A.D. under King Clovis, with a brief interruption during World War II (1940-1944) when the capital was moved to Vichy during German occupation. Located in northern France on the Seine River, Paris is not only the political center of France but also one of the world's most important cultural, economic, and tourist destinations. It is home to iconic landmarks such as the Eiffel Tower, the Louvre Museum, and Notre-Dame Cathedral, and hosts the French government including the presidential Élysée Palace and Parliament.
